situation.estimate: Series C scale-up (founded 2020, Berlin, 300+ staff, 8 offices) that crossed $100M ARR in mid-2026 after doubling three years running, and raised $80M on 4 Nov 2026 to expand in the US/Canada and push 'agentic payments' (MCP access for AI agents). It has two motions: corporate cards/spend for businesses (vs Pleo, Moss, Payhawk, Spendesk in Europe) and white-label card programs for banks, fintechs and software platforms (vs Enfuce, Mynt, Stripe Issuing, Swan, Solaris). Marketing is restarting content after a near-silent 2025: English posts resumed March 2026 and a US-targeted comparison push landed one week after the round, while the German blog (home market) has had no new post since Oct 2025. The direction is US expansion plus the bank/platform side, so the new search work is US/English; DACH SMB/mid-market visibility looks left to legacy content.

seo_need.why_not_yet: never_prioritized (partly): sales/partner-led growth with heavy PR; the blog was near-silent Oct 2024 - Mar 2026 and the German blog is dormant, while competitors kept investing. Evidence that it is now being picked up for the US/CaaS side (Nov 2026 listicles and versus pages, Website PM hire with technical SEO), so the gap is DACH + spend-management + AI visibility rather than zero activity.
